cells.reason: invalid: 46 ok of 50 main-census curves; frozen rule makes the cell invalid, so no power or equivalence bound is assessable

method: Per cell from the raw job records: S, M, V (n-1 sample variances), kappa, z = (S-M)/sqrt(1.05 V) and sigma_kappa = sqrt(1.05 V)/M. delta_min_z_only = 4 sigma_kappa is the plan's formula (z conjunct only). The frozen flag rule is the conjunction |kappa-1| >= 0.10 AND |z| > 4, so its effective threshold on |kappa_hat-1| is max(0.10, 4 sigma_kappa). Normal approximation: kappa_hat ~ N(1+delta, sigma_alt^2) with sigma_alt = sigma*sqrt(1+delta) (Poisson-like scaling), for sigma = sigma_kappa (sigma_null) and for sigma = max(sigma_kappa, bootstrap sd of kappa) (sigma_emp). flag power = P(|kappa_hat-1| >= threshold, same sign). p_read_null = P(|kappa_hat-1| < 0.05 and kappa_hat +- 1.96 sigma_boot inside [0.90, 1.10]) with sigma_boot from the recorded ci95 width. Equivalence bound = max |ci95 - 1| of the recorded interval (and of a reviewer bootstrap: 2000 curve-cluster resamples, reviewer seed). excess_coincidences_per_set = (S-M)/curves.
